beats: A rhino's horn is not bone.
It is keratin, the protein in hair and fingernails, with no bone inside.
audio: music: Bach, Air (US Air Force Strings) (Public domain, Wikimedia Commons)
ai_disclosure: none needed (real footage, no AI imagery or voice)
alt_text: Video of a greater one-horned rhinoceros walking along a grassy track towards the camera in Manas National Park, Assam, India, with text explaining its horn is made of keratin, not bone.
